title: Uprise
summary: UPRI'SE, verb intransitive s as z. pret uprose; participle passive uprisen. 1. To rise from bed or from a seat. Uprose the virgin with the morning light. 2. To ascend above the horizon. Uprose the sun

inlines.v: UPRI'SE, verb intransitive s as z. pret uprose; participle passive uprisen. 1. To rise from bed or from a seat. Uprose the virgin with the morning light. 2. To ascend above the horizon. Uprose the sun. 3. To ascend, as a hill. obsolete UPRI'SE, noun A rising; appearance above the horizon. obsolete
